claims: The Hunger Games franchise is based on Suzanne Collins' novels.
The Hunger Games franchise follows Katniss Everdeen, who volunteers to compete in a televised, mandatory fight-to-the-death competition in the nation of Panem.
The 2012 film adaptation of The Hunger Games was directed by Gary Ross.
Jennifer Lawrence stars in the 2012 film adaptation of The Hunger Games.
The 2012 Hunger Games film is set in a post-apocalyptic North America.
In the 2012 Hunger Games film, 12 districts are forced by the wealthy Capitol to send one boy and one girl (ages 12-18) to compete in the Hunger Games.
Katniss Everdeen volunteers for her sister in District 12 in the 2012 Hunger Games film.
Jennifer Lawrence (Katniss Everdeen) is in the main cast of the 2012 Hunger Games film.
Josh Hutcherson (Peeta Mellark) is in the main cast of the 2012 Hunger Games film.
Liam Hemsworth (Gale Hawthorne) is in the main cast of the 2012 Hunger Games film.
Woody Harrelson (Haymitch Abernathy) is in the main cast of the 2012 Hunger Games film.
Elizabeth Banks (Effie Trinket) is in the main cast of the 2012 Hunger Games film.
Donald Sutherland (President Snow) is in the main cast of the 2012 Hunger Games film.
The 2012 Hunger Games film was produced by Lionsgate and Color Force.
The 2012 Hunger Games film had a $78 million budget.
The 2012 Hunger Games film launched a five-film series.
The Hunger Games film series includes The Hunger Games (2012).
The Hunger Games film series includes Catching Fire (2013).
The Hunger Games film series includes Mockingjay – Part 1 (2014).
The Hunger Games film series includes Mockingjay – Part 2 (2015).
The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes (2023) is a prequel in the Hunger Games film series.
Sunrise on the Reaping is scheduled for release in November 2026.
